005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import org.wpilib.math.linalg.MatBuilder;
010import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
011import org.wpilib.math.linalg.VecBuilder;
012import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N1;
013import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N2;
014import org.wpilib.math.system.LinearSystem;
015import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
016
017/**
018 * Filters the provided voltages to limit a differential drive's linear and angular acceleration.
019 *
020 * <p>The differential drive model can be created via the functions in {@link
021 * org.wpilib.math.system.Models}.
022 */
023public class DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter {
024  private final LinearSystem<N2, N2, N2> m_system;
025  private final double m_trackwidth;
026  private final double m_minLinearAccel;
027  private final double m_maxLinearAccel;
028  private final double m_maxAngularAccel;
029
030  /**
031   * Constructs a DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter.
032   *
033   * @param system The differential drive dynamics.
034   * @param trackwidth The distance between the differential drive's left and right wheels in
035   *     meters.
036   * @param maxLinearAccel The maximum linear acceleration in meters per second squared.
037   * @param maxAngularAccel The maximum angular acceleration in radians per second squared.
038   */
039  public DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter(
040      LinearSystem<N2, N2, N2> system,
041      double trackwidth,
042      double maxLinearAccel,
043      double maxAngularAccel) {
044    this(
045        requireNonNullParam(system, "system", "DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter"),
046        trackwidth,
047        -maxLinearAccel,
048        maxLinearAccel,
049        maxAngularAccel);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Constructs a DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter.
054   *
055   * @param system The differential drive dynamics.
056   * @param trackwidth The distance between the differential drive's left and right wheels in
057   *     meters.
058   * @param minLinearAccel The minimum (most negative) linear acceleration in meters per second
059   *     squared.
060   * @param maxLinearAccel The maximum (most positive) linear acceleration in meters per second
061   *     squared.
062   * @param maxAngularAccel The maximum angular acceleration in radians per second squared.
063   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if minimum linear acceleration is greater than maximum linear
064   *     acceleration
065   */
066  public DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter(
067      LinearSystem<N2, N2, N2> system,
068      double trackwidth,
069      double minLinearAccel,
070      double maxLinearAccel,
071      double maxAngularAccel) {
072    requireNonNullParam(system, "system", "DifferentialDriveAccelerationLimiter");
073    if (minLinearAccel > maxLinearAccel) {
074      throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxLinearAccel must be greater than minLinearAccel");
075    }
076    m_system = system;
077    m_trackwidth = trackwidth;
078    m_minLinearAccel = minLinearAccel;
079    m_maxLinearAccel = maxLinearAccel;
080    m_maxAngularAccel = maxAngularAccel;
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Returns the next voltage pair subject to acceleration constraints.
085   *
086   * @param leftVelocity The left wheel velocity in meters per second.
087   * @param rightVelocity The right wheel velocity in meters per second.
088   * @param leftVoltage The unconstrained left motor voltage.
089   * @param rightVoltage The unconstrained right motor voltage.
090   * @return The constrained wheel voltages.
091   */
092  public DifferentialDriveWheelVoltages calculate(
093      double leftVelocity, double rightVelocity, double leftVoltage, double rightVoltage) {
094    Matrix<N2, N1> u = VecBuilder.fill(leftVoltage, rightVoltage);
095
096    // Find unconstrained wheel accelerations
097    var x = VecBuilder.fill(leftVelocity, rightVelocity);
098    var dxdt = m_system.getA().times(x).plus(m_system.getB().times(u));
099
100    // Convert from wheel accelerations to linear and angular accelerations
101    //
102    // a = (dxdt(0) + dx/dt(1)) / 2
103    //   = 0.5 dxdt(0) + 0.5 dxdt(1)
104    //
105    // α = (dxdt(1) - dxdt(0)) / trackwidth
106    //   = -1/trackwidth dxdt(0) + 1/trackwidth dxdt(1)
107    //
108    // [a] = [          0.5           0.5][dxdt(0)]
109    // [α]   [-1/trackwidth  1/trackwidth][dxdt(1)]
110    //
111    // accels = M dxdt where M = [0.5, 0.5; -1/trackwidth, 1/trackwidth]
112    var M = MatBuilder.fill(Nat.N2(), Nat.N2(), 0.5, 0.5, -1.0 / m_trackwidth, 1.0 / m_trackwidth);
113    var accels = M.times(dxdt);
114
115    // Constrain the linear and angular accelerations
116    if (accels.get(0, 0) > m_maxLinearAccel) {
117      accels.set(0, 0, m_maxLinearAccel);
118    } else if (accels.get(0, 0) < m_minLinearAccel) {
119      accels.set(0, 0, m_minLinearAccel);
120    }
121    if (accels.get(1, 0) > m_maxAngularAccel) {
122      accels.set(1, 0, m_maxAngularAccel);
123    } else if (accels.get(1, 0) < -m_maxAngularAccel) {
124      accels.set(1, 0, -m_maxAngularAccel);
125    }
126
127    // Convert the constrained linear and angular accelerations back to wheel
128    // accelerations
129    dxdt = M.solve(accels);
130
131    // Find voltages for the given wheel accelerations
132    //
133    // dx/dt = Ax + Bu
134    // u = B⁻¹(dx/dt - Ax)
135    u = m_system.getB().solve(dxdt.minus(m_system.getA().times(x)));
136
137    return new DifferentialDriveWheelVoltages(u.get(0, 0), u.get(1, 0));
138  }
139}
